faq1Q: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later?
faq1A: Yes! You can switch plans at any time. When upgrading, the price difference is prorated. When downgrading, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing cycle.
faq2Q: What happens when my free trial ends?
faq2A: When your trial ends, you'll be asked to choose a paid plan to continue using smart replies. Your templates and settings are preserved — nothing is lost.
faq3Q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq3A: Absolutely. You can cancel anytime from your account settings. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.
faq4Q: What payment methods do you accept?
faq4A: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) through Stripe, our secure payment provider.
faq5Q: What happens when I reach my smart reply limit?
faq5A: When you reach your monthly smart reply limit, template-based replies continue working normally. Only AI-powered smart replies pause until your limit resets at the start of the next billing cycle. You can upgrade anytime for more replies.
